content.title: 10 Best Things To Do For Cinco De Mayo In Miami This Year
content.text: Looking for Cinco de Mayo plans? We've got you covered with exciting events happening around the city, and yes, they involve plenty of tequila! Oh! Mexico Commonly mistaken for Mexican Independence Day, the fifth of May actually commemorates Mexico’s victory in the 1862 Battle of Puebla. And while it’s not generally considered a major holiday there, it has become a significant celebration of Mexican American culture and pride in the U.S. This year, the holiday falls on a Tuesday, pero there’s still plenty of events and promotions going on around the 305 in honor of this fun feast. Not to mention, it also gives us the perfect excuse to down a couple of margs in the middle of the week! Whether you’re looking for a massive block party or culturally rooted dinner, we’ve gathered the best ways to spend your Cinco de Mayo in Miami. Cinco de Wynwood SWARM Dubbed the city’s largest Cinco de Mayo block party, Wynwood Marketplace is bringing the energy with multiple DJs spinning Latin beats, live mariachi performances and even mechanical bull rides on May 5th. Fuel up on street food favorites like tacos and elotes, and wash it all down with oversized margaritas or tequila shots. General admission is free with an RSVP, but you can opt for their open bar option. Jacinta de Mexico Jacinta de Mexico Honoring the true history of the holiday, Aventura Mall’s Jacinta is introducing “Five Days of Fiesta.” From May 1 to 5, savor a special Sabores de Puebla menu featuring authentic Pueblan dishes like duck confit enmoladas, chalupitas and rich almond mole. Each evening at 5 p.m., the restaurant pauses for El Brindis (The Toast) to honor Mexico’s 1862 victory at the Battle of Puebla. Then raise a glass with one of their specialty margaritas and catch a live mariachi performance on the big day (May 5). Tequila Town Tequila Town For a truly immersive Cinco de Mayo, Tequila Town is hosting a high-energy Mercado celebration that lets you sip your way through eight different bars, each featuring its own cocktail and food pairing! The night includes a build-your-own margarita station, live mariachi and DJ mashups, roaming performers and vibrant dancers. What more could you really need? Mayami Wynwood Courtesy of Mayami For an unforgettable night out, Mayami is bringing its signature blend of bold flavors and entertainment this Cinco de Mayo. Celebrate until 3 a.m. with $5 tacos and $5 tequila shots available until midnight, or go all out with $250 bottles of Don Julio 70. A mariachi band will also set the festive mood while you choose from the restaurant’s a la carte menu, featuring dishes like Hot Ceviche, Pulpo Criollo and their melty Fundido de Queso. Oh! Mexico Oh! Mexico With three locations across Miami Beach, Oh! Mexico lets you choose exactly how you want to celebrate! Head to Lincoln Road for a classic, family-friendly fiesta with live mariachis, or stroll down Española Way for a romantic evening featuring mariachi serenades. If late night partying is more your thing, hit up Ocean Drive for a high-energy party with DJs and flowing tequila. No matter where you choose, you’ll get to enjoy authentic Mexican cuisine alongside 2-for-1 José Cuervo Tradicional shots. Cinco de Chela’s From happy hour specials to mariachi performances and even an hora loca, Chela’s Cocteleria is turning Cinco de Mayo into an absolute blowout! It all goes down at 4 p.m. with an indoor happy hour featuring $7 margaritas, $5 tequila shots and tons of tacos while Power 96 broadcasts live. Outside, the lawn will host several pop-up bars featuring Don Julio Margaritas and other cocktails with Ketel One Vodka, Union Mezcal, Canaima Gin and Saratoga Water. Guests’ only form of currency to get food and goodies will be in the form of tickets. Rosa Sky Rosa Sky Take your Cinco de Mayo celebrations to the 22nd floor at Rosa Sky Rooftop. From 7 p.m. to 2 a.m., take in the sweeping skyline views while plenty of DJs spin tracks accompanied by visual projections. While you groove, enjoy festive bites like Miso-Mezcal Glazed Tuna Tostadas topped with wasabi guacamole, mango-black bean street corn and pickled radish, perfectly paired with a classic Michelada or a $10 Patrón Blanco shot. Bakan Grupo Bakan Known for its vibrant atmosphere, Bakan transports guests straight to Mexico with fresh handmade tortillas, regional dishes and an impressive bar boasting over 500 mezcals and tequilas! Grab a seat on Tuesday, May 5th, and enjoy the live mariachi band that will be serenading guests throughout the evening. Bagatelle Miami River x Sala de Despecho Bagatelle Miami River Bagatelle Miami River is getting a one-of-a-kind transformation as Sala de Despecho takes over for the holiday. This collaboration blends Riviera style dining with Mexico’s famous heartbreak-fueled party experience. Expect an evening bursting with French Mediterranean elegance and Latin passion through live singing, sing-along anthems and performances from the Sala de Despecho collective. Guests can indulge in Bagatelle’s signature dinner menu alongside exclusive Cinco de Mayo-inspired specials. Lime Fresh Mexican Grill Lime Fresh Mexican Grill Bringing the kids along? Lime Fresh Mexican Grill is throwing a family-friendly party across all of its Broward and Miami-Dade locations. On May 5, take advantage of their extended patio seating and enjoy live DJs, swag giveaways, face painting for the kids and interactive patio games like Cornhole and Jumbo Jenga.
